title: How are you guys using AI for Pine Script development?
author: Jealous_Win2699
selftext:
I've been experimenting with using AI to speed up Pine Script development.

The workflow is pretty simple:

1. Describe the strategy in plain English
2. Generate an initial Pine Script
3. Review and fix the code
4. Backtest it in TradingView
5. Iterate from there

I recently found a tool specifically designed around this workflow:

[https://tradingviewai.dev/](https://tradingviewai.dev/)

I'm not expecting AI to write a perfect strategy automatically, but having it generate the first draft seems pretty useful.

How are you guys using AI when working with Pine Script?
